title: Marketing & Sales
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora posees el vocabulario técnico necesario para presentar campañas de marketing, cerrar ventas y entender el mercado como un verdadero ejecutivo comercial.

parts.visual:
Audiencia y Posicionamiento: 
- Target audience (Público objetivo / Target). 
Ej: Our target audience is young professionals. 
- Brand awareness (Reconocimiento de marca). 
Ej: The campaign is designed to increase brand awareness. 
- Niche market (Mercado nicho / Especializado). 
Ej: We sell vegan cosmetics, which is a niche market.
parts.audio: Audience and Positioning. 'Target audience' means the specific group of people you want to reach. For example: Our target audience is young professionals. 'Brand awareness' is how well consumers recognize your brand. For example: The campaign is designed to increase brand awareness. A 'niche market' is a small, specialized market. For example: We sell vegan cosmetics, which is a niche market.

parts.visual:
Técnicas de Venta: 
- Cold calling (Llamadas en frío a clientes potenciales que no te conocen). 
Ej: I hate doing cold calling. 
- Sales pitch / Pitch (Discurso de venta o presentación corta). 
Ej: She gave a brilliant pitch to the investors. 
- Conversion rate (Tasa de conversión / Porcentaje de visitantes que compran). 
Ej: Our website has a 5% conversion rate.
parts.audio: Sales Techniques. 'Cold calling' is calling potential customers who haven't asked to be contacted. For example: I hate doing cold calling. A 'Pitch' or 'Sales pitch' is a short presentation to persuade someone to buy or invest. For example: She gave a brilliant pitch to the investors. 'Conversion rate' is the percentage of visitors who actually buy something. For example: Our website has a 5 percent conversion rate.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de marketing o ventas correcto.

questions.question: The people we are trying to sell our product to are our ____ audience. (Público objetivo).
We need to increase brand ____ so more people recognize our logo. (Reconocimiento de marca).
He spent all morning doing cold ____ to find new clients. (Llamadas en frío).
questions.explanation: Cold calling = llamadas en frío a clientes que no lo han solicitado.

questions.question: The CEO loved your sales ____. He wants to invest! (Discurso de venta / Presentación corta).
questions.explanation: Sales pitch (o solo pitch) = discurso o presentación para persuadir.

questions.question: We are targeting a ____ market: people who own pet iguanas. (Mercado nicho / Especializado).
questions.explanation: Niche market = segmento de mercado muy especializado.

questions.question: 100 people visited the site, but only 2 bought something. The ____ rate is 2%. (Tasa de conversión).
questions.explanation: Conversion rate = tasa de conversión (porcentaje de usuarios que realizan una acción deseada).

questions.question: To get more customers, we are going to launch an advertising ____. (Campaña).
Our main ____ in this market is Apple. (Competidor).
This feature gives us a competitive ____ over other brands. (Ventaja competitiva).
We sent out a ____ to ask customers about their preferences. (Encuesta/Cuestionario).
The ____ line shows our total revenue before expenses. (Línea superior / Ingresos brutos).
questions.explanation: Top line = ingresos brutos / ventas totales (bottom line = ganancia neta).

questions.question: A free trial is a great way to generate ____ for our software. (Contactos/Posibles clientes).
questions.explanation: Generate leads = generar prospectos / clientes potenciales.

questions.question: Our ____ is what makes us different from everyone else. (Unique Selling Proposition).
questions.explanation: USP (Unique Selling Proposition) = propuesta única de venta.

questions.question: Word-of-____ marketing is very effective because people trust their friends. (Boca a boca).
We need to do more market ____ before launching the product. (Investigación).
The physical products a company sells are called ____ goods. (Bienes de consumo).
B2B means Business to ____. (Empresa a Empresa).
B2C means Business to ____. (Empresa a Consumidor).
Giving out free ____ is a great way to let people test the food. (Muestras).
A celebrity ____ can boost sales significantly. (Respaldo / Promoción por un famoso).
questions.explanation: Endorsement = respaldo público, a menudo pagado, por parte de una celebridad.
